name: Sarah Jenkins
psychographics: Views convenience as a professional necessity; believes delegating domestic tasks allows her to focus on high-stakes cases.
current_solutions: M&S Ocado weekly food slot; Gousto meal kits for occasional weekend cooking; Deliveroo for emergency lunches.
frustration: Her Ocado delivery slot was cancelled 30 minutes before the driver arrived, leaving her with an empty fridge and a critical deposition prep session starting in 45 minutes.
decision_style: Sticks to trusted brands; will pay extra for guaranteed delivery windows rather than risking cheaper, unreliable alternatives.
voice: Formal and measured; peppered with legal jargon even when describing mundane errands, often qualifying statements with "in my experience..."
